title: Native derived localization of a specified ordinary evaluation
statement: Let T,D be arbitrary native module complexes on a scheme with condensed coefficients. Suppose a specified kappa identifies section D with ordinary Hom(section T,B[0]), and specified natural chain isomorphisms epsilon for every target factor through the normalized ordinary evaluation. Assume D is K-flat and ordinary Hom(section T,-) sends every quasi-isomorphism to a quasi-isomorphism. Fix any native/ringed-site derived comparison S,M,t,theta satisfying the displayed evaluation counit compatibility. Then there exists delta:QD≅native RHom(QT,unit) such that the native localization tensor comparison is invertible for every target and the displayed localization equation with epsilon holds. The result does not construct the comparison data, assert invertibility of the evaluation transpose, or involve scalar modules, finite freeness, bounds or basis inverses. The exact quantifiers and equation follow in lean.statement.

source.place: Tags 08JH and 08JJ; finite-free dual calculation and evaluation localization.

proof.text: Write E for the exact section equivalence and L=ET, D-section=ED. Full quasi-isomorphism invariance of ordinary Hom(L,-) applies to the fixed K-injective augmentation of every target, including the coefficient unit complex. Therefore the specified ordinary-to-derived Hom comparisons are isomorphisms. Compose localized kappa with the unit Hom comparison to identify Q(ED) with RHom(QL,B).

For a flat-term K-flat resolution Q→EF, the ordinary evaluation localization theorem applies to L,Q and the given ordinary evaluation formula. Its uniqueness clause identifies its canonical evaluation with the aEF in the hypothesis. K-flatness is transported from native D through the section equivalence. The localized tensor comparison for the resolution and D identifies the resulting map with the closed transpose of evaluation into the coefficient unit, followed by the target unit constraint.

For the original unbounded target, naturality of epsilon and Hom invariance imply that tensoring the resolution arrow with D is a quasi-isomorphism: the square has isomorphic horizontal arrows and a quasi-isomorphism on the Hom side. Naturality of the localization comparison then implies it is invertible on the original target, and naturality of the evaluation transpose carries the equality from the resolution to that target. No termwise flatness of D is needed: D and the resolution are K-flat.

Use the supplied evaluation counit compatibility of S,M,t,theta. Adjunction transposition identifies the derived transpose computed by the preceding steps with the native two-braiding evaluationTranspose. Transport the section dual isomorphism through the derived equivalence to obtain delta. The tensor comparison and localization isomorphisms give exactly the stated map equation for every original target. This step uses the fixed native adjunction; it does not choose a different tensor or assert invertibility of the evaluation transpose.

theorem nativeOrdinaryEvaluationLocalization
    (T D : CochainComplex (Internal Λ X) ℤ)
    (κ : (complexForward Λ X).obj D ≅
        homComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1} (R := ring Λ X) ((complexForward Λ X).obj T)
          (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{u + 1, u, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ring Λ X)))
    (ε : ∀ F : CochainComplex (Internal Λ X) ℤ,
        (complexForward Λ X).obj
            (internalTotalTensor Λ X F D) ≅
          homComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1} (R := ring Λ X) ((complexForward Λ X).obj T)
            ((complexForward Λ X).obj F))
    (hevaluation : ∀ F : CochainComplex (Internal Λ X) ℤ,
      ∃ aEF : (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ring Λ X)).obj
          ((complexForward Λ X).obj F,
            homComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1} (R := ring Λ X) ((complexForward Λ X).obj T)
              (ringedTensorUnitComplex.{u + 1, u, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ring Λ X))) ⟶
            homComplex.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1} (R := ring Λ X) ((complexForward Λ X).obj T)
              ((complexForward Λ X).obj F),
        RingedOrdinaryEvaluationFormula.{u + 1, u, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ring Λ X)
          ((complexForward Λ X).obj T) ((complexForward Λ X).obj F) aEF ∧
        (ε F).hom = (totalComparison Λ X F D).hom ≫
          (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ring Λ X)).map
            (𝟙 ((complexForward Λ X).obj F), κ.hom) ≫ aEF)
    (hnatural : ∀ {F G : CochainComplex (Internal Λ X) ℤ} (f : F ⟶ G),
      (complexForward Λ X).map ((@tensorRight _ _ (internalComplexMonoidal Λ X) D).map f) ≫
        (ε G).hom =
        (ε F).hom ≫ ((homComplexFunctor.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1} (R := ring Λ X)).obj
          (op ((complexForward Λ X).obj T))).map
            ((complexForward Λ X).map f))
    (hkflat : ∀ Z : CochainComplex (Internal Λ X) ℤ, Z.Acyclic →
      (internalTotalTensor Λ X Z D).Acyclic)
    (hhom : ∀ (F G : CochainComplex (Modules Λ X) ℤ) (f : F ⟶ G),
      QuasiIso f → QuasiIso (((homComplexFunctor (R := ring Λ X)).obj
        (op ((complexForward Λ X).obj T))).map f))
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (hom Λ X))
      (M : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ring Λ X) S)
      (t : TensorComparison Λ X S M)
      (θ : Functor.uncurry.obj (CondensedRing.derivedHom Λ X) ⋙ forward Λ X ≅
        ((forward Λ X).op.prod (forward Λ X)) ⋙ hom Λ X)
    (hcounit : ∀ K N : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Internal Λ X),
        (forward Λ X).map
          ((@BraidedCategory.braiding _ _ _ (internalBraiding Λ X)
              (((CondensedRing.derivedHom Λ X).obj (op K)).obj N) K).hom ≫
            (CondensedRing.derivedTensorHomAdjunction Λ K).counit.app N) =
          (t.iso.hom.app (((CondensedRing.derivedHom Λ X).obj (op K)).obj N, K)) ≫
            S.tensor.map
              (X := ((forward Λ X).obj (((CondensedRing.derivedHom Λ X).obj (op K)).obj N),
                (forward Λ X).obj K))
              (Y := ((hom Λ X).obj (op ((forward Λ X).obj K), (forward Λ X).obj N),
                (forward Λ X).obj K))
              (θ.hom.app (op K, N), 𝟙 ((forward Λ X).obj K)) ≫
            S.evaluation ((forward Λ X).obj K) ((forward Λ X).obj N)) :
    ∃ δ : DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 1}.obj D ≅
        ((CondensedRing.derivedHom Λ X).obj
          (op (DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 1}.obj T))).obj
            (nativeUnit Λ X),
    ∀ F : CochainComplex (Internal Λ X) ℤ,
      IsIso (localizationTensorMap Λ X F D) ∧
      (forward Λ X).map
          ((((CondensedRing.derivedTensor Λ X).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 1}.obj F)).map
            δ.hom) ≫
            evaluationTranspose Λ X (DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 1}.obj T)
              (DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 1}.obj F)) ≫
          sectionDerivedHomMap Λ X θ T F =
        (forward Λ X).map
            (localizationTensorMap Λ X F D) ≫
          (localizationIso Λ X).hom.app
            (internalTotalTensor Λ X F D) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 1}.map (ε F).hom ≫
          ringedOrdinaryHomComparison.{u + 1, u, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ring Λ X)
            ((complexForward Λ X).obj T) ((complexForward Λ X).obj F)
